title: BC032913 as a Novel Antisense Non-coding RNA is Downregulated in Gastric Cancer.
abstract: Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) are a subset of non-coding RNAs. Abnormal expression of lncRNAs is associated with the development of cancers including gastric cancer (GC). Increasing evidence in this field reveals that lncRNAs have a key role in biological actions via modulating the expression of genes at various genomic levels. BC032913, as a novel antisense lncRNA, may have a role in GC progression.
